# Contributing

How to contribute to XWiki is detailed on the following document: https://dev.xwiki.org/xwiki/bin/view/Community/Contributing.

* [Development practices](https://dev.xwiki.org/xwiki/bin/view/Community/DevelopmentPractices): the rules XWiki development follows (issues, commits, pull requests, backward compatibility).
* [Security policy](https://dev.xwiki.org/xwiki/bin/view/Community/SecurityPolicy/): how to report a vulnerability. Never report one in a public issue or pull request.
* [Forum](https://forum.xwiki.org/): questions and discussion of a contribution before starting it.
